title: When the Rivergate Turns
premise: Jude Thornbury, a railroad engineer who keeps a map of closed lines and a habit of never sleeping in the same town twice, is hired to survey a shuttered mountain spur near Rivergate. When a government survey team vanishes from the same valley—leaving their gear stacked neatly and no tracks—Jude realizes the closed lines she's been mapping were closed for a reason someone is willing to kill over. Racing a salvage fleet that wants the vanished team's cargo before the glacier calving season opens the route for six tides only, Jude must decide whether loyalty to the people who once saved her matters more than the truth of what they did. She reaches the wreck on the fifth tide, exposes the conspiracy behind both the closure and the disappearance, and chooses to stop moving—handing her map to the authorities and staying in Rivergate as its new line engineer.
about_author: Mara Coldharbour spent a decade working seasonal rail contracts across northern mountain passes before turning to fiction full-time. Her novels are known for technical precision, unforgiving landscapes, and protagonists who measure trust in miles.

chapters.title: The Map That Never Unfolds
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. In the rail town of Harrow Bend, Jude takes a contract to survey the closed Rivergate spur, hiding her map of dead lines beneath false ledger pages. A stranger asks too many questions about her last employer. Emotional beat: restless competence masking the fear that stopping means being found.

chapters.title: Six Tides
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. The harbormaster explains the glacier calving season: the river gorge opens for exactly six tides before ice seals it. Jude calculates her survey window and realizes someone else has done the same math—the salvage fleet is already provisioning. Emotional beat: the tick of an invisible clock beginning.

chapters.title: Gear Without Tracks
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. On the old spur, Jude finds the government team's camp intact—boots by the fire, instruments zeroed, food untouched—but no footprints leaving in any direction. Emotional beat: dread sharpening into obsession; the engineer in her refuses data that doesn't add up.

chapters.title: What the Lines Were Closed For
chapters.summary: Jude's POV, with a flashback to her mentor Vess. Digging through county records, Jude learns the spur was closed after a rockslide that officially killed no one—and unofficially buried something the railroad never reported. Emotional beat: the past pressing against the present like water against a door.

chapters.title: The Fleet at Anchor
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. In Rivergate's harbor, Jude watches the salvage fleet load cutting gear and dynamite under a private charter signed by a name she recognizes from the county records. Emotional beat: cold clarity—the race is no longer about a wreck but about evidence.

chapters.title: An Old Debt Rides Along
chapters.summary: Jude's POV introducing Tam, a river pilot who once smuggled Jude out of a town where she'd testified against a rail baron. Tam offers passage upriver; Jude can't tell if it's friendship or a leash. Emotional beat: gratitude tangled with suspicion—loyalty vs. truth begins its argument.

chapters.title: First Tide
chapters.summary: Tam's POV. The gorge opens; ice groans and shifts. They run the river ahead of the fleet's lead barge, and Tam reveals he was paid to bring Jude here by someone who knew her map existed. Emotional beat: betrayal surfacing mid-current, trust renegotiated stroke by stroke.

chapters.title: The Neat Camp, Explained
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Following a hidden tramway cut into the canyon wall, Jude finds where the survey team actually went—an underground junction sealed since the closure, entered deliberately. One member left a coded logbook. Emotional beat: relief curdling into horror; they didn't vanish, they descended.

chapters.title: Logbook of the Fifth Man
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Deciphering the logbook, Jude learns the team found the thing the rockslide buried—a payroll vault and records proving the closure was staged to hide embezzlement and deaths. The team split: some took payment to stay silent; one refused. Emotional beat: grief for strangers who died for arithmetic.

chapters.title: Vess's Signature
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Among the payoff signatures in the logbook is her mentor Vess—the man who taught her to keep moving. Emotional beat: devastation; the person who saved her helped bury the truth, and every mile she ran may have been bought.

chapters.title: Interception at the Narrows
chapters.summary: Tam's POV. The salvage fleet catches them at the narrows; there's a tense standoff on the water, and Jude barges past using a derelict lock only she knows how to work. Emotional beat: defiant ingenuity, but the fleet now knows exactly where she's headed.

chapters.title: The Town That Sold Its Silence
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Back in Rivergate, Jude confronts the harbormaster and learns the whole town was paid annually to forget the closure—her own contract was bait to legitimize the salvage claim. Emotional beat: isolation crystallizing; nowhere upstream or down is neutral ground.

chapters.title: Second Tide, Rising Water
chapters.summary: Tam's POV. They push upriver again as meltwater raises the current; a crewman defects from the fleet and confirms the plan is to blast the junction shut forever with the evidence inside. Emotional beat: urgency hardening into resolve—this is no longer escape, it's intervention.

chapters.title: The Lockkeeper's Daughter
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. An old woman whose father kept the derelict locks gives Jude the original closure orders her father hid—signed by the same rail baron Jude once testified against. Emotional beat: the map of her own life redrawing itself; her running was never random.

chapters.title: Third Tide: The Junction Door
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Reaching the underground junction, Jude finds the surviving team member—the fifth man—who faked his disappearance to keep the records safe and has been living in the dark for weeks. Emotional beat: wary alliance; two people who stopped trusting everyone learning to trust each other.

chapters.title: What Loyalty Costs
chapters.summary: Tam's POV. Tam confesses fully: he took the fleet's money intending to double-cross them, but his confession forces Jude to choose between protecting him and protecting the evidence. Emotional beat: the loyalty-vs-truth theme at knife-point; she chooses neither cleanly.

chapters.title: Fourth Tide: The Blast
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. The fleet detonates the canyon rim early, collapsing part of the junction entrance and trapping the fifth man inside with the records. Jude goes in after him as the tide turns. Emotional beat: terror transmuted into purpose; the engineer becomes the rescue.

chapters.title: Fifth Tide: The Wreck
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Inside the flooded junction, Jude reaches the vault wreck, recovers the records and the fifth man, and rigs the tunnel to survive the fleet's second charge. Emotional beat: triumph measured in seconds; she beats the deadline by one tide.

chapters.title: The Sixth Tide
chapters.summary: Tam's POV. As the final tide opens, Jude stands down the fleet's captain not with force but with copies already sent downstream by the lockkeeper's daughter—destruction is pointless now. Emotional beat: victory without violence; truth arriving faster than dynamite.

chapters.title: Testimony
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. In the Rivergate courthouse, Jude gives testimony that names Vess, the baron, and the town's complicity, then hands over her map of closed lines—every secret road she ever used to disappear. Emotional beat: the cost of justice made visible; she unmakes her own armor.

chapters.title: Reopening
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Months later, crews reopen the spur under state oversight with Jude as chief engineer; the fifth man takes the first run as conductor. Emotional beat: quiet restoration; a closed line becoming a promise kept.

chapters.title: Where Jude Stops
chapters.summary: Jude's POV, closing frame mirroring chapter one. In Harrow Bend, someone asks the stranger's question again—where is she headed next—and Jude answers: nowhere. She unfolds the map one last time and lets the wind take it. Emotional beat: stillness chosen freely; the journey ends because she finally stays.
